Resolves #21628

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613

Adds `examples/board/wipLimits`, a 16-repair precision workshop Kanban board across four stages (`Waiting` with 6 cards and no limit, `On the bench` with limit 3 holding 4 cards at the start, `Testing` with limit 2 holding 2 cards, and `Ready for pickup` with 4 cards and no limit), backed by `Neo.data.Store` (`MainStore`) and `Neo.board.CardModel` (`CardModel`). `WorkshopColumn` extends `Neo.board.Column` (`columnModule: WorkshopColumn`) to render a custom-styled `[ −  limit N  + ]` pill stepper beside each limited column's title and a non-colour overload banner (`▲ Over limit by N — move a repair or raise limit`) alongside the engine's `count/limit` badge and `neo-board-column-wip-exceeded` class, updating both columns' badges and overload states atomically on card drop or stepper adjustment.

**Catalog record for #21613:**
- `id`: `'board-wip-limits'`
- `name`: `'Work-in-progress limits'`
- `feature`: `'Columns with a limit: the header counts against it, and an overloaded stage stands out'`
- `lookFor`: `'The bench is over its limit of 3. Move a repair on to Testing: the bench recovers, and Testing goes over.'`
- `cover`: The board with the bench marked at `4/3` (`wiplimits-1440x900-dark.jpg`).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + guards ran`

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E `WipLimits.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine` CI + headless Chromium `1440 × 900` & `390 × 844` dark/light renders at rest and mid-drag over the overloaded column, and two swapped-order cold-look evaluations) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-7). Residual: none for #21628; batch catalog publication lives in #21613.

## Deltas from ticket

- Disabled horizontal column reordering (`columnsResortable: false`) so clicking the inline WIP steppers inside `.neo-board-column-header` never competes with header drag gestures (`#21632` covers column reordering separately).
- Honored `Column.css:13` (`/* Over its limit, the header's edge and badge speak; a full outline would read as a drop target */`): at rest, `.neo-board-column-wip-exceeded` marks its top edge, warm header surface, `4/3` pill, and solid-bordered `▲ Over limit by 1` banner while keeping neutral side/bottom column edges; during drag-over (`:has(.neo-board-card-slot)`), the full column outline and `.neo-board-card-slot::after` dashed insertion slot light up in amber.

Frame critique: Self-inspection and Round-1 cold reads (`1e6b8b6e`, `70ef5631`) caught six defects and nits, all resolved before Round 2: (1) `.workshop-hint` text was blank due to root `vdom.text` reset on `Component` — moved into `cn` span; (2) full 4-sided amber column outline at rest conflicted with `Column.css:13` — scoped full outline + amber `.neo-board-card-slot::after` to `:has(.neo-board-card-slot)` during drag while keeping header surface + `3px` top accent at rest; (3) dashed warning banner mimicked the dashed drag drop-slot — switched `.workshop-wip-over-banner` to solid border + `3px` left accent; (4) `On the bench` truncated to `On the b...` at `390 × 844` — wrapped `.workshop-wip-stepper` onto row 2 below the full title at `<= 720px` and shortened the mobile top-bar pill; (5) light-mode `.neo-dragproxy` card border was faint over white cards — applied `--workshop-focus` (`#0a7a6e`) to `body:has(.workshop-viewport) .neo-dragproxy > .neo-board-card`; (6) unified bench card accents to `#38bdf8` (reserving amber for WIP overload), styled `Testing`'s `2/2` pill with `workshop-wip-at-limit` purple parity, and matched `Ready for pickup`'s emerald dot. Remaining accepted trade-offs: `On the bench`'s inline alert banner offsets its first card ~44px below un-alerted neighbors, and the 6th `Waiting` card (`Technics SL-1200 tonearm gimbal`) peeks at the bottom edge on `390 × 844` as a vertical scroll cue.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: `WorkshopColumn` relies on the engine's header keeping exactly three children. That holds while a column is unlocked, because `updateHeader` truncates to three (`Column.mjs:593`). A locked column takes the other branch, which writes the lock glyph into `cn[3]` without truncating (`Column.mjs:584`), so the next `push` (`WorkshopColumn.mjs:195`, `:204`) appends the stepper and banner after stale copies under the same ids. No stage here is locked, so this example never reaches it; a reader who copies the column into a board with `locked: true` would. Non-blocking.

Two optional polish notes on the same head, neither blocking:
- `syncStageSummary` re-derives `wipLimit != null && count > wipLimit` and the `count/limit` text (`Viewport.mjs:165-167`). `col.isWipExceeded` is the engine's predicate, and reading it keeps an example that others copy on one source.
- The id-less `insertNode` counter (`WipLimits.spec.mjs:57-66`) parses the main thread's log line (`DeltaUpdates.mjs:1114`) and has no positive control: if that line's shape changes, it counts nothing and `toBe(0)` (`:112`) still passes. Counting the `update` lines it sees and asserting that count is above 0 would make it fail closed.
